peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why is maltodextrin used in spray drying?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: It serves as a bulking agent, providing volume and texture to products. Furthermore, maltodextrin acts as a stabilizer, improving the shelf life and preventing the undesirable effects of moisture on food products.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What are the steps of the spray drying process?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The spray-drying process consists of four fundamental steps: (i) atomization of the liquid feed, (ii) drying of spray into drying gas, (iii) formation of dry particles and (iv) separation and collection of the dry product from the drying gas [2–4].
